mathematics.assertion_tested: For the declared 85 rational parameter cases, browser odd coefficients equal independent Python dense Taylor coefficient extraction; exact sample evaluations, local tail formulas, recurrence contributions, component-swap symmetry, scalar sinh values, validation and serialization controls hold.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q, reduced integer fractions in JavaScript BigInt and Python Fraction
mathematics.conventions: N is the retained coefficient count, indices 0 through N-1 and highest degree 2N-1. Coefficients are ordinary Taylor coefficients, not derivatives. The omitted-series envelope is R*(R^2/2)^N/(1-R^2/2).
inputs: All 81 ordered scale quadruples in {1/4,1/2,3/4}^4 with six retained coefficients
The default (1/3,2/3,1/2,3/4) with twelve retained coefficients
Two boundary-oriented cases with denominator 100 and sixteen coefficients
The all-half case with one retained coefficient
non_claims: The finite audit is not a new proof of entire existence, convergence or inverse theorems
The tested grid is not every admitted rational parameter quadruple
Rounded plots are not interval evaluations
The browser runtime and BigInt implementation are not formally verified
No new Lean declarations or coverage are claimed
